card.title: Who Cares More?
card.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I kept twelve tickets from our trips. How many did you keep?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: None. I made you that album instead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And I kept it. Your care is safe because of mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Open it. I put all my tickets inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'm preserving both our collections. Let me get it a waterproof cover.

mechanism: A uses preserved souvenirs and each counterexample to claim a greater share of caring through safeguarding both people's memories.
confusable: Unlike simply valuing keepsakes, A must compare care and convert B's contribution into A's superiority.
comparison: D91-a makes preserving an album outweigh making it; D91-b makes carrying the heavier side outweigh shared effort.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
